mentions.name: ClickLens
mentions.description: A modern, user-friendly web interface for managing and monitoring ClickHouse databases. It provides native RBAC using ClickHouse grants to control data access and UI permissions, Kibana-like flexible data exploration for any granted table, and a SQL console with monitoring and logging all in one place.
mentions.audience: Developers, analysts, and administrators working with ClickHouse clusters
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://github.com/ntk148v/clicklens

It's a modern, powerful, and user-friendly web interface for managing and monitoring ClickHouse databases. It provides a comprehensive suite of tools for developers, analysts, and administrators to interact with their ClickHouse clusters efficiently.
